flags.note: Double genitive construction מהעדה של עפהיזום appears redundant. Classical Hebrew would use either construct chain עדת עפהיזום or single של construction.
Classical Hebrew would prefer construct chain מנורות זהב rather than analytical של construction for simple material composition.
The sequence של+pronoun שהמה reflects Greek syntax. Classical Hebrew would use הם or omit the pronoun entirely in the relative clause.

flags.hebrew: תמיה לי מפני מה תעזוב אתה
flags.note: This word order with the redundant pronoun אתה after the verb mimics Greek syntax. Hebrew would typically omit the pronoun or place it differently.

flags.hebrew: ובאם לאו במהרה ידחף... באם שלא תעשה
flags.note: The repetitive conditional structure באם...באם with excessive coordination suggests Greek influence. Hebrew would use more varied subordination.
The phrase הכתר מהחיים appears to calque Greek τὸν στέφανον τῆς ζωῆς. Hebrew would more naturally use כתר החיים.

flags.hebrew: וגם עדות טובה ובזה העדות שם חדש כתוב שלא יוכל שום אחד לקרוא רק זה שקיבל אותו
flags.note: This extremely long paratactic sentence with multiple coordinated clauses strongly suggests Greek influence. Hebrew would use more subordination and shorter clauses.
The awkward כמה כמו construction appears to reflect Greek comparative syntax rather than natural Hebrew simile construction.
The positioning of the demonstrative pronoun ההמה between the noun and prepositional phrase reflects Greek article usage rather than Hebrew demonstrative placement.
